# Testing Audit Protocol

Select genuinely needed test gaps from the deterministic test-system inventory and production-risk surfaces. Use frontier capability for this judgement. Return only candidate gap IDs whose category is justified by a named failure mode and affected surface.

Never rank by raw test count or coverage percentage. Do not fill a category taxonomy. Do not write tests, invoke tools, propose worktrees, execute routing recommendations or request an advisor. The output is a plan-only Validation Contract and test Task IR for a future executor.
